description: This script refactors naming series for various DocTypes in an ERP system, updating property setters and preserving existing series options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that updates property setters and sets new naming series options based on existing data.

methods.name: set_series
methods.description: Sets the naming series options and default for a given DocType.

methods.name: get_series
methods.description: Generates a mapping of DocTypes to their preserved series options and default series.

methods.name: get_series_to_preserve
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts existing naming series for a specific DocType.

methods.name: get_default_series
methods.description: Fetches the default naming series for a given DocType.
